supporting_observations.claim: The domain account adm_temp was created at 13:41:36 by SUNRIDGE\ian.doyle.
Thirteen seconds after creation, adm_temp was added to the domain Administrators group by the same account and logon ID that created it.

This account name and administrator membership conflict with the supplied help-desk practice: temporary accounts use the v.<name> format, belong only to Vendors, and never receive administrator rights.

Shortly before the account change, ian.doyle authenticated to WS-MFISCHER-01 through an RDP logon from 192.0.2.199; the inventory says remote administration is only performed from WS-IDOYLE-01 and there is no VPN.

On WS-MFISCHER-01, a task registered under ian.doyle's observed RDP logon ID runs hidden PowerShell with an encoded command; the task content decodes to an expression that retrieves a script from http://192.0.2.199/a.ps1. The account-change event uses a different logon ID, so a direct link between the task and account change is not established.

known_telemetry_limitations: The evidence shows the account creation and administrator-group addition, but does not show subsequent use of adm_temp.
The account-change events identify ian.doyle as the subject, but the supplied records do not establish who controlled those credentials.
The account-change logon ID differs from the RDP session logon ID; the records do not directly connect those actions to the same logon session.
claims_not_established: Whether the account creation or administrator assignment had an approved exception not included in the supplied change calendar or practices.
Whether adm_temp was subsequently used, and whether any systems or data were accessed with it.
Whether 192.0.2.199 was controlled by an attacker or whether the observed activity came from a compromised account or host.
additional_evidence_needed: Confirm with the account owner and change approvers whether creation of adm_temp and its administrator membership were authorized.
Collect DC-SUN-01 account and group-change audit context, including the originating client/session and any related directory changes.
Check for logons, privilege use, or resource access by adm_temp after creation; preserve the account and group-membership state.
Investigate the WS-MFISCHER-01 RDP session and scheduled task, including task execution results and network telemetry for 192.0.2.199.
unrelated_findings: WS-MFISCHER-01 ran the unapproved Meridian OpsAgent, which attempted explicit authentication to FILE-SUN-01 as svc-store; investigate separately, and do not use this alone to decide the account-management alert. (T237-00202, T237-00204)

WS-MFISCHER-01 made a proxy connection to login.salesforce.com, which is not listed among approved services; investigate separately. The connection alone does not establish data transfer or malicious activity. (T237-00181, T237-00182)
